evidence.title: New Worlds: We are living in the future of J.G. Ballard or William Gibson

summary: The rapid advancement of AI technologies is creating a reality akin to the dystopian or cyberpunk futures imagined by authors like J.G. Ballard and William Gibson. Experts debate whether this signals progress or a cautionary tale about humanity's relationship with technology.
title: AI Shapes a Future Resembling Sci-Fi Visions of Ballard and Gibson
